title: Invertibility of the distinguished simple object of a finite tensor category
difficulty_reason: The input tells us duals of indecomposable projectives are projective and gives tensor-product multiplicity formulas. The new proof singles out ρ=D(0) by dualizing the unit cover, computes the coefficient identity N^i_{ρ,j*}=δ_{D(i),j} by comparing Hom(P_i*,X_j) with Hom(1,P_i⊗X_j), and converts it into a global permutation of projective covers under Xρ*⊗−. Thus the special simple has FPdim 1 and is invertible. The joint extraction of the candidate from the unit-cover socle and its action on all projective covers is not supplied by the earlier projectivity, duality, or ordinary dimension criteria. Preserve the entire author derivation before the lemma and its closing argument as one H2.
